semiconductor_relevance: High — Kubota specializes in surface defect inspection systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Kubota develops advanced surface defect inspection systems that leverage their expertise in optics, imaging, and precision machinery. Their product offerings include laser-based and microscope-based systems designed to detect minute defects in semiconductor wafers, enhancing quality control and process efficiency.
capabilities: Laser-based defect detection systems capable of identifying defects as small as PSL 50nm
Microscope-based systems for inspecting transparent materials with high-performance image processing
Hybrid systems combining laser and microscope technologies
AI functionality for improved defect discrimination accuracy
